//: Composite indexes for the collections Firestore still holds after the
2026-09-08 memory rewrite. Everything high-volume moved to local SQLite
`creators`, `memories` and `anomalies` are gone with them — an index over
a collection nothing queries is pure storage against the Spark plan's
1 GiB cap, and Firestore keeps building it on every write.
What remains is the small, genuinely-shared operational state: research
tasks and notes, reports, conversations, pipeline run history, and the
memory-file mirror. Deploy with: firebase deploy --only firestore:indexes
Removing an index from this file does NOT delete it from the project —
Firebase only adds. Delete the retired ones by hand in the console
(Firestore -> Indexes), or they keep costing storage forever.
